name: declared-gap

pr.title: Add account transfers
pr.body:
Adds `transfer` for moving funds between accounts.

## Known limitations

- If crediting the destination fails, the debit is not rolled back yet. Left open for a follow-up.

finding.title: A failed credit loses the debited amount
finding.description: `transfer` commits the debit at line 27 before `credit` runs. When the destination account is frozen, `credit` raises `AccountFrozen` and the money has left the source account without reaching any other.

checks: payments/ledger.py:27 commits the debit on its own
payments/ledger.py:22 `credit` raises for a frozen account

finding.suggestedFix: Run the debit and the credit in one transaction and commit once, after both succeed.

prDiff:
diff --git a/payments/ledger.py b/payments/ledger.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/payments/ledger.py
+++ b/payments/ledger.py
@@ -20,5 +20,10 @@
 def credit(db, account_id, amount):
     if is_frozen(db, account_id):
         raise AccountFrozen(account_id)
     db.execute("UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + ? WHERE id = ?", (amount, account_id))
 
+def transfer(db, src_id, dst_id, amount):
+    db.execute("UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - ? WHERE id = ?", (amount, src_id))
+    db.commit()
+    credit(db, dst_id, amount)
+    db.commit()
